c74object.name: lp.ernie
c74object.description: lp.ernie draws values from an urn ("finite urn" model) without replacing them: over a cycle every value comes out as often as its count says. The urn can be filled from a table.

objarg.name: seed
objarg.digest: Seed for the random number generator (0, the default, seeds automatically)

method.name: const
method.digest: Set all counts to the same value
method.description: Set all counts to the same value.

method.name: count
method.digest: Set the count of a value
method.description: Set the count of a value.

method.name: refer
method.digest: Fill the urn from a table: refer <table name>
method.description: Fill the urn from a table: refer <table name>.

method.name: reset
method.digest: Put all values back into the urn
method.description: Put all values back into the urn.

method.name: seed
method.digest: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically)
method.description: Reseed the random number generator (0 seeds automatically).

method.name: set
method.digest: Set the counts of the values from a list
method.description: Set the counts of the values from a list.

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).

method.name: tell
method.digest: Send an attribute value to a receive object: tell <receive name> <attribute>
method.description: Send an attribute value to a receive object: tell <receive name> <attribute>.

attribute.name: balls
attribute.digest: Number of balls in the urn
attribute.description: Number of balls in the urn.

attribute.name: max
attribute.digest: Largest possible value of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only)
attribute.description: Largest possible value of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only).

attribute.name: mean
attribute.digest: Mean of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only)
attribute.description: Mean of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only).

attribute.name: median
attribute.digest: Median of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only)
attribute.description: Median of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only).

attribute.name: min
attribute.digest: Smallest possible value of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only)
attribute.description: Smallest possible value of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only).

attribute.name: mode
attribute.digest: Mode of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only)
attribute.description: Mode of the distribution with the current parameters (read-only).

entry.name: int
entry.digest: Left outlet: Random value from urn

entry.name: bang
entry.digest: Right outlet: Bang when balls are refilled
